mutations.name: start-without-call-id
mutations.what: tool_start does not say which call it is, so two calls to one tool in a turn cannot be paired

mutations.name: result-without-call-id
mutations.what: tool_result / tool_error do not say which call they answer

mutations.name: result-without-input
mutations.what: tool_result carries its callId but not the path or command, so it cannot be read without its start

mutations.name: recoverable-error-without-call-id
mutations.what: the tool_error of a call the Hub refused to dispatch (unknown function) does not say which call it was

mutations.name: checkpoint-is-never-noted
mutations.what: the checkpoint the guard made for a call is not put on the record of the call

mutations.name: checkpoint-id-is-sticky
mutations.what: a call that made no checkpoint (a read) inherits the id of the previous call's

mutations.name: guard-does-not-tell-the-agent
mutations.what: the guard makes the checkpoint and never says which call it belongs to

patches.old: await onCheckpoint?.({ id: snap.id, partial: snap.partial === true || (snap.skipped?.length ?? 0) > 0, reused: snap.reused === true, targeted: snap.targeted === true });

mutations.name: input-carries-the-text-of-the-file
mutations.what: the input of a write contains the content it writes

patches.new:
if (path !== null) input.path = clip(path, PATH_CHARS);
  if (typeof args.content === 'string') input.content = args.content;

mutations.name: input-does-not-know-file
mutations.what: the tools that name their file `file` are not announced by path

mutations.name: command-is-not-cut
mutations.what: a command of any length is copied into the event

mutations.name: path-is-not-cut
mutations.what: a path of any length is copied into the event

mutations.name: all-paths-are-listed
mutations.what: a batch of 50 files lists 50 paths

mutations.name: route-takes-the-whole-checkpoint-request
mutations.what: a request can make a checkpoint that belongs to a task

mutations.name: reject-while-a-task-runs
mutations.what: a created file is moved while the agent is waiting for a decision

patches.old: if(taskEngine?.state()?.activeTaskId)throw Object.assign(new Error('Chờ agent dừng trước khi từ chối file nó đã tạo.'),{code:'task_in_progress',statusCode:409});

mutations.name: reject-under-sandbox-only
mutations.what: a created file is moved out of the host workspace in sandbox-only mode

patches.old: if(gate?.executionPolicy==='sandbox-only')throw Object.assign(new Error('Sandbox-only: không chuyển file khỏi workspace trên Windows host.'),{statusCode:403});

mutations.name: save-while-a-task-runs
mutations.what: the editor saves a file while the agent is waiting for a decision

patches.old: if(taskEngine?.state()?.activeTaskId)throw Object.assign(new Error('Đợi agent dừng trước khi lưu file từ editor.'),{statusCode:409});

mutations.name: review-route-does-not-say-when-the-task-stopped
mutations.what: what the person wrote after a task stopped is listed in the review of that task
